senses.sense_definition: A mutual exchange of privileges, actions, or feelings between people or groups.

examples.text: Healthy relationships require a balance and a clear sense of <w>reciprocity</w> between both partners.
She showed little interest in emotional <w>reciprocity</w>, preferring to focus solely on her own needs.

senses.sense_definition: The practice of granting equal rights, privileges, or obligations between governments or nations.

examples.text: The trade agreement was reached on the basis of strict <w>reciprocity</w> between both nations.
Both governments agreed on visa <w>reciprocity</w> to make international travel easier for their citizens.

senses.sense_definition: The grammatical property of expressing a reciprocal relation between participants.

examples.text: Linguists analyze how different languages express <w>reciprocity</w> through pronouns or verb morphology.
In this sentence, <w>reciprocity</w> is indicated by the use of the reciprocal pronoun phrase.
